summary: Vistance Networks filed an 8-K disclosing a Purchase Agreement to sell its RUCKUS reporting segment to Belden Inc. for $1.846 billion in cash on a cash-free, debt-free basis, subject to customary adjustments. No premium is stated as the segment is not publicly traded. The board recommends the transaction; no advisors named. Closing expected in H2 2026, subject to HSR waiting period and other regulatory consents, absence of material adverse effect on the business, completion of the restructuring to separate the business, delivery of carveout financials, and lien releases. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and execution of the separation.
